threads.body: [Testing] The deadlock regression remains untested: existing tests verify buffering and delivery, but none proves that `Factory.create()`/`log()` runs without holding the store lock. Please add a deterministic concurrency test where the logging callback waits for a second thread to complete a lock-taking store operation (for example, `currentSize()` with a timeout); the old implementation should time out while this one completes.

replies.body: this is just a simple lock scope reduction, no rigorous test needed
